subject.title: [Feature](skill-workshop): quarantined proposals are a dead end — missing restore action, scan findings display, and chat entry point

question: What recovery transition should quarantined Skill Workshop proposals support without allowing unchanged scanner-blocked content to bypass or endlessly repeat the security gate?
rationale: Source establishes the dead end, but whether quarantine may be cleared unchanged, only after revision and rescan, or only dismissed is an intentional security and product policy choice.

options.title: Revise, rescan, then restore
options.body: Allow quarantined proposals to be revised or rejected, returning them to pending only after the revised content receives a fresh scan.

options.title: Unchanged manual restore
options.body: Permit an explicit quarantined-to-pending transition while retaining findings, accepting the risk that apply may immediately quarantine the same content again.

options.title: Dismissal only
options.body: Allow rejection or deletion from quarantine but require users to create a new proposal for corrected content.

recommendation.title: Revise, rescan, then restore
recommendation.body: Allow quarantined proposals to be revised or rejected, returning them to pending only after the revised content receives a fresh scan.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Skill Workshop proposal lifecycle work is the strongest available ownership signal for choosing recovery semantics.
